item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
• Battery, charge state and dock/link detection for the Astro A50 Gen 4
  • Estimated runtime on battery and estimated time to full while charging, learned from the observed rate
  • Full parametric equalizer: three slots with per-band gain, centre frequency and bandwidth
  • 15 loadable EQ presets, including the five originals from Astro Command Center and ten from The ZEFERENCE by ZaliaS
  • Mix, microphone and stream-output controls
  • Automatic updates via Sparkle
